prompts.name: Anchor Recall
prompts.subject: A massive forged navy-steel nautical ANCHOR being hurled forward through deep water in a powerful diagonal from lower left toward upper right, two thick curved pointed flukes and a broad crossbar clearly recognizable; aged brass trim, bright silver beveled edges. A taut chain with large interlocking steel links trails behind toward the lower left, conveying hook-and-recall. Forceful cyan water wake, a few readable droplets and turbulent bubbles. The anchor dominates; no character, no impact crater, no shield.
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE finished premium square mobile action-MOBA ability icon for Dimensions Front, Nerok the cyber shark. Primary request: match the premium digital-painted science-fantasy game illustration direction of Andromeda Timmy's new icons: dimensional painted materials, polished brushwork, dramatic controlled lighting, broad striking silhouettes and layered atmosphere that remain identifiable at 64px. Square 1024x1024 artwork, opaque illustrated full-bleed background. Nerok's palette is dark ocean navy, cobalt, vivid turquoise and icy white with restrained aged brass highlights. Underwater/ocean pressure atmosphere, deep blue depths, drifting bubbles and expressive water movement. Main subject must sit within the central 75% safe circle for circular HUD cropping, occupies 60-70% of the frame; no key feature at corners. Crisp subject separated from slightly subdued background. No text, letters, digits, borders, frames, badges, UI controls, logos, watermark or collage. Exactly ONE square icon, not a sheet. Avoid flat vector glyphs, cheap primitive shapes, excessive thin lines, clutter, photorealism. Input reference image 1 is only an identity/material reference for the existing heavy anchor, brass/steel/navy materials and the five attack concepts; do not copy its flat render style or multi-icon layout. Subject: A massive forged navy-steel nautical ANCHOR being hurled forward through deep water in a powerful diagonal from lower left toward upper right, two thick curved pointed flukes and a broad crossbar clearly recognizable; aged brass trim, bright silver beveled edges. A taut chain with large interlocking steel links trails behind toward the lower left, conveying hook-and-recall. Forceful cyan water wake, a few readable droplets and turbulent bubbles. The anchor dominates; no character, no impact crater, no shield.

prompts.name: Pressure Hull
prompts.subject: A substantial front-facing nautical ARMORED SHIELD surrounded by a translucent curved dome of pressurized cyan WATER. Navy armored face, thick silver bevel, aged brass raised spine and a restrained round turquoise reactor; the shield's broad protective silhouette is the focal point. Surrounding water wraps tightly around the shield, white foam deflecting sideways from both edges and bubbles held outside the barrier. Deep cobalt sea background, strong cyan rim lighting, beautifully painted thick metal. No anchor, no character, no offensive explosion, no multiple shields.

No whirlpool, no anchor, no shield, no character, no fire.

prompts.name: Abyssal Maelstrom
prompts.subject: Ultimate attack: an immense obliquely viewed ABYSSAL OCEAN WHIRLPOOL, broad spiral arms of cobalt and turquoise water converging inward into a deep nearly black central funnel. Three or four substantial foam-lined spiral ridges clearly distinguish the inward rotating vortex from a breaking wave. Brilliant icy cyan rim and turbulent floating droplets, dramatic deep-sea atmosphere, impressive scale and depth. The dark funnel is centered safely inside the middle of the image and outer spiral remains circular-crop readable. No anchor, shield, text or character, no galaxy, no portal, no fire.

prompts.name: Anchor Strike
prompts.subject: Basic melee attack: the massive forged navy-steel nautical ANCHOR at the instant of a SHORT HEAVY DOWNWARD STRIKE into a submerged stone surface, two broad curved pointed flukes, brass trim and silver beveled edges remain clearly recognizable. Anchor angled from upper left to lower right; impact is within central safe area. A compact sharp white/cyan splash, a few dark stone chips and restrained amber impact sparks, short curved water motion wake conveys the heavy close-range hit. Anchor is large and dominant. This should look distinct from Anchor Recall: NO long trailing chain, no flying pose; grounded impact and compact arc. No character, shield or giant vortex.
